about.title: ABOUT

intro.role: Lê Xuân Hội (Bryan) is a UI/UX Designer focused on interfaces, user experiences, and design systems for digital products.
intro.summary: He combines design thinking with an understanding of user needs to create clear, usable, and consistent experiences for websites and applications.
intro.philosophy: Each solution starts with understanding user needs and behaviour, defining the problem, mapping user flows, and testing prototypes to improve usability through iteration.
intro.location: Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

current.description: Designing web and app experiences, from information architecture and user flows to detailed interfaces and a consistent system of UI components.

particula.description: Collaborated on UI/UX design for a tokenized-asset analytics SaaS platform, focusing on data organization, dashboard experiences, and a consistent interface system.

approach.title: MY APPROACH
approach.text: I begin by understanding users and product goals, then define the problem, organize information, and map user flows. Ideas take shape through wireframes and prototypes before detailed UI design, usability reviews, and collaboration with developers to bring the experience into the product.
